from.place: Component-extension part of the supported localization triangle theorem.

title: Component maps extend to a triangle morphism (second variable)
statement: For the corresponding supported localization triangles, the three specified supported exterior-product components extend to a morphism of triangles. This is the component-extension conjunct of [lem-pur-supported-product-localization].

source.place: Tag 09XP and Tag 0F1E; compatibility of the supported pairing with localization boundaries.

proof.text: Construct the triangle morphism from the canonical supported exterior-product maps and verify the three commutation equations, including the normalized connecting-map square and tensor shift sign.

proof_origin: The component-extension conjunct is isolated from the complete proof plan of the parent supported localization theorem.
